title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Senior Delphi Developer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Developer with 5+ years of Delphi software development experience to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Write well-designed, testable, documented code from the provided project requirements
  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Implement software changes with the awareness and sensitivity of impact on the system as a whole
  • Learn and adhere to the adopted coding standards used by the software ERP Development Team
  • Leverage Delphi experience and learn all other client development tools
  • Monitor assigned software development change requests and implement changes for requests based on priority
  • Review requirements for system changes and enhancements, analyze those requests, and translate them into necessary programming changes
  • Perform necessary designing, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation (using the Delphi IDE and any other necessary tools)


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of Delphi and SQL Server experience (FireDAC experience is a plus)
  • Experience with at least one object-oriented programming language (in addition to Delphi/Object Pascal) is a plus, e.g., Java, C#, C++, etc.
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, cross-training, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Implementing unit tests (DUnitX experience is a plus)


Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry and any related applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding the fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning and management tools such as GitHub
  • Working with AI tools within the development workflow


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis , essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Tipspace

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.


Tecnologias do Projeto

Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:

  • Bancos de Dados relacionais
  • Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
  • SQL para consultas estruturadas
  • Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
  • Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código


Responsabilidades

Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
  • Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
  • Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção.


Requisitos

Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:

  • Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
  • Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
  • Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
  • Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso.


Benefícios e Condições

  • Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
  • Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
  • Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
  • Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa.


Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!


Boa sorte e até breve

title: Data Architect
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados .

Mandatory skills:

1. Arquitetura & Modelagem de Dados

Modelagem multidimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake)

Data Warehouse e projetos complexos de modelagem

2. Engenharia de Dados em Cloud (AWS)

Criação e curadoria de pipelines

Serviços serverless (Spark, Glue, Lambda)

Formatos de tabela (Delta Lake, Iceberg)

3. Programação & Bancos de Dados

SQL avançado (Redshift, SQLDW, Postgres)

Stored Procedures, UDFs, ETL (Talend)

4. Infraestrutura & Orquestração

Kubernetes (obrigatório)

Terraform; Linux e sistemas distribuídos

5. CI/CD & Observabilidade

Jenkins, GitOps

Grafana, Kibana, Cloud Logging

6. Metodologias & Comunicação

Metodologias Ágeis

Inglês fluente

Key responsabilities:

  • Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura AWS Serverless DataLake, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e suporte a múltiplos workflows de dados.
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e enriquecimento usando AWS Lambda, Glue e serviços serverless correlatos.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para entender requisitos, priorizar entregas e garantir soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Mentorar engenheiros de dados mais juniores, promovendo boas práticas e desenvolvimento técnico.
  • Avaliar e adotar novos serviços AWS, buscando melhorias contínuas de performance, eficiência e inovação.
  • Monitorar e solucionar problemas do DataLake (performance, erros de processamento, infraestrutura).
  • Otimizar storage e acesso aos dados (S3, Athena, Redshift, DynamoDB) garantindo alta performance.
  • Definir modelos e esquemas de dados alinhados às necessidades de analistas e data scientists.
  • Atuar com tecnologias de orquestração de containers quando necessário (Kubernetes).

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil:
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
Blue Dot , headquartered in São Paulo, is a leading company in the Contact Center and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment, with over 10 years of international experience. Specialized in Staffing solutions for companies in the United States, we connect highly qualified talent in Brazil with global career opportunities.


Our operation is strategically located in one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world, allowing us to access a broad, diverse, and highly skilled workforce.


Value Package for the Professional


  • Compensation: R$ 3,500.00
  • Structured career plan: real opportunities for growth into leadership positions
  • Professional stability: permanent position with a long-term focus
  • Continuous development: regular technical and behavioral training
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with international exposure


Mandatory Requirements


  • Fluent English (C1 or C2 level, both spoken and written) – will be assessed during the process
  • Clear, professional, and objective communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, productivity focus, and multitasking ability
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, or automation tools
  • 1 year experience in related roles


General Job Information


  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Brasília time)
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Work model: 100% remote


Key Responsibilities


You will act as a strategic remote support professional for our clients in the United States, focusing on operational efficiency, service excellence, and commercial support. Responsibilities include:


Executive and Administrative Support


  • Managing calendars, meetings, and appointments
  • Handling corporate emails and preparing executive reports
  • Supporting administrative routines


International Recruitment


  • Sourcing and screening candidates for U.S.-based roles
  • Conducting cold calls, interviews, and follow-ups
  • Scheduling interviews and onboarding processes
  • Updating and maintaining databases


Commercial Support

  • Prospecting and qualifying leads
  • Conducting market research and interacting via CRM, email, and LinkedIn
  • Assisting with sales reports and forecasts


Customer Experience (CX)

  • Providing support via phone, email, and chat
  • Efficiently resolving customer requests
  • Collecting feedback and supporting retention strategies


Project Management (PMO)

  • Assisting with timelines, meetings, and task delegation
  • Updating documents and tracking deliverables
  • Supporting social media, content creation, and data entry


Accounts Receivable (Finance)

  • Issuing and sending invoices
  • Monitoring payments and tracking outstanding balances
  • Assisting in preparing financial reports


Desired Profile

  • Analytical, resilient, and strategic mindset
  • Ability to adapt to different demands and industries
  • Interest in building a long-term international career


How to Apply


Submit your application and become part of a team committed to excellence, connecting professionals with leading companies in the international market.


If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you via LinkedIn.

title: Data Analyst
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,500 - $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join their team. This role will play a critical part in driving data-informed decision-making across their organization. The Data Analyst will be responsible for developing and maintaining business intelligence dashboards and structuring and evaluating holdout tests.


The ideal candidate has a strong analytical foundation, hands-on experience with BI tools, a solid understanding of experimentation methodologies (including incrementality and holdout testing), as well as strong communication skills to closely collaborate with executive-level stakeholders.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute automated reports and dashboards across key business functions, including marketing, inventory management, merchandising, and pricing.
  • Assess creative performance using Motion to identify trends in content, formats, or products to improve their marketing mix.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests, ensuring statistical rigor and providing clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with marketing and product teams to evaluate incremental lift and long-term impact using holdout and experimentation frameworks.
  • Monitor and evaluate business performance against established KPIs, identifying trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including marketing, product, finance, and sales—to understand data needs and proactively deliver insights that support business objectives.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, experimentation, and analytical best practices.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • 1-3 years of professional experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data modeling).
  • Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, including A/B testing, holdout testing, and experimental design.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands is a plus


Work Schedule : US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing eCommerce brand setting new standards in digital marketing and customer acquisition.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Company Overview:Lean Tech is a rapidly expanding organization situated in Medellín, Colombia. We pride ourselves on possessing one of the most influential networks within software development and IT services for the entertainment, financial, and logistics sectors. Our corporate projections offer a multitude of opportunities for professionals to elevate their careers and experience substantial growth. Joining our team means engaging with expansive engineering teams across Latin America and the United States, contributing to cutting-edge developments in multiple industries.
Position Title:  Mid+ Site Reliability EngineerLocation: Remote - LATAM
What you will be doing:We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to drive reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across our SaaS platform. This role is critical in improving incident response, system observability, and performance optimization, while proactively preventing disruptions.As part of the Cloud Operations organization, you will lead post-incident investigations, implement preventative strategies, and partner with Engineering and Observability teams to enhance system resilience. You will also play a key role in building automation, improving time-to-resolution (TTR), and enabling a data-driven approach to reliability.
Requirements & Qualifications To excel in this role, you should possess:
  • Strong expertise in SRE practices, incident management, and production operations.
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as:
    • New Relic
    • Datadog
    • Sumo Logic
    • or similar platforms
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting (e.g., JavaScript, .NET, SQL).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, Azure acceptable).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architectures and distributed systems.
    Experience troubleshooting C#/.NET web applications and performance issues.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with:
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Strong troubleshooting experience in:
    • Windows environments
    • SQL Server
  • Previous experience as a:
    • Software Engineer
    • System Administrator
Soft Skills:
  • Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
Why you will love Lean Tech:
  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. 
Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Join one of the most exciting early-stage platforms as we scale our engineering team globally.


You’ll be building on your full-stack experience, evolving a platform that balances cutting-edge tech with real-world stability. We are looking for a pragmatic \"builder\" who is comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and can take a feature from a raw idea to a polished delivery.


This is a 100% remote contract role (PJ) for a developer based in Brazil, reporting to our US/UK-based leadership. You’ll be central to our product delivery, working across the entire stack to ensure our users have a seamless, reliable experience.


Some of your day-to-day will be:

  • Full-Stack Development: Owning features from end-to-end using TypeScript and React.
  • Backend & Data: Building and maintaining robust services with Postgres and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Product Evolution: Supporting ongoing feature delivery and improving stability across key user flows.
  • Code Quality: Contributing to a maintainable codebase as the platform grows, balancing speed with long-term reliability.
  • Smart Engineering: Utilizing modern tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery without losing sight of fundamental coding principles.


Requirements:

  • Mid-to-Senior Experience: Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React).
  • Database Fluency: Proven experience with relational databases (Postgres or similar).
  • Startup Mindset: Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where requirements evolve.
  • Independent Operator: Able to take ownership of tasks and work autonomously to hit delivery goals.
  • Communicator: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to collaborate with our international team.
  • Pragmatic: A focus on \"what works\" and \"what scales,\" avoiding over-engineering where it isn’t needed.


Benefits:

  • International Contract (PJ): Competitive remuneration.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in Brazil.
  • Direct Impact: Work directly with the founding team; no layers of middle management.
  • Modern Stack: Access to the latest development tools and a clean, high-velocity environment.
  • Growth: Opportunity to grow alongside the platform as we scale.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Você será responsável por desenhar a arquitetura de sistemas agênticos de alta complexidade, garantindo que nossos agentes não apenas funcionem, mas sejam resilientes, seguros e otimizados em produção.


Responsabilidades:

·Arquitetura Agêntica Avançada : Projetar fluxos de trabalho complexos (ex: Multi-Agent Systems) onde múltiplos agentes colaboram para resolver problemas, definindo padrões de comunicação e estado.

·Otimização e Escala : Liderar iniciativas de melhoria de latência e redução de custos de inferência (tokens), otimizando a engenharia de prompt e estratégias de caching.

·Governança de Observabilidade : Definir os KPIs técnicos de qualidade dos agentes (ex: hallucination rate, faithfulness) e configurar os alertas críticos no LangFuse/Arize.

·Mentoria Técnica : Atuar como referência para desenvolvedores Plenos e Juniores, realizando code reviews rigorosos focados em segurança e clean architecture para IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações

·Python: Domínio da ferramenta (assincronismo, tipagem avançada, performance).

·Agentic Frameworks: Domínio em orquestração de frameworks agênticos. Capacidade de customizar ou estender esses frameworks quando necessário.

·LLMOps & Observabilidade: Experiência comprovada em instrumentação de observabilidade.

·Cloud & Infra (AWS): Experiência com arquitetura serverless para IA e IaC.

·Inglês conversacional para colaboração técnica global.

·Lifelong Learning: Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo, com proatividade para dominar novas tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas de IA Generativa.

title: Customer Operations & Finance Support
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Operations & Finance Support professional to join our team and play a key role in managing premium enterprise customer accounts within a structured ITIL‑based operations model.


This role combines customer service leadership, finance & accounting ownership, and IT service management , making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across functions, engaging with senior stakeholders, and driving operational excellence in a multinational environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Create, update, and manage customer data within internal ITIL tools to support end‑to‑end service workflows
  • Own and manage the financial health of customer accounts , including:
  • Monthly Balance Sheet preparation & review
  • Account reconciliations
  • P&L analysis and variance explanations
  • Perform financial analysis and reporting to support business and management decisions
  • Lead customer onboarding and offboarding for SAP ECS accounts , coordinating with cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Work directly with Premium Customers , ensuring a high‑quality, reliable service experience
  • Monitor customer service metrics, analyze trends, and take proactive actions to improve delivery
  • Measure, track, and improve overall customer experience levels
  • Analyze support workflows and propose improvements for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage support operations in a 24x5 model , ensuring smooth workload handovers and SLA compliance
  • Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Support management with forecasting, budgeting , and performance tracking vs. plan
  • Lead and support customer service teams through transitions, service introductions, or operational changes
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to align customer service outcomes with company goals


✅ What You Bring


  • Experience working in an Operations Support model
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience in frontline customer management , including executive‑level interactions
  • Proven experience managing Finance & Accounting aspects of customer accounts
  • Hands‑on experience with ITIL processes , including:
  • Incident Management
  • Service Request Management
  • Change Management
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data analysis and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross‑cultural environment


Nice to Have


  • Project management experience in service transition and/or service introduction
  • Experience with common customer service and ITSM tools
  • Exposure to enterprise or SAP‑based customer environments


Please submit resumé in English

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [TECH LEAD - FULL STACK]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Atuar na implantação e evolução de projetos com Machine Learning , desde a concepção até o deploy em produção
  • Definir e sustentar arquiteturas modernas (cloud, microserviços, APIs, dados)
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de problemas complexos e tomada de decisão técnica
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções tecnológicas
  • Garantir governança técnica, observabilidade e performance das aplicações
  • Promover cultura de melhoria contínua, inovação e compartilhamento de conhecimento



Requisitos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) fullstack e/ou líder técnico(a)
  • Vivência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e cloud (AWS ou Azure)
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Node.js, React native, React.js, GraphQL, Nest.js
  • Experiência prática na implantação de soluções com Machine Learning em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade

title: AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

﻿

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an AI Engineer who has built agents that are live in production at real companies, not demos, not prototypes that died after a pitch, not research projects. We need someone who has shipped agentic systems that enterprises depend on every day, and who understands the full lifecycle: scoping the business problem, designing the agent architecture, integrating with messy enterprise systems, building evaluation and monitoring, and keeping it running reliably.


This role sits across two priorities equally: building their internal multi agent AI platform and delivering agent based solutions directly to enterprise clients. You will work closely with their engineering team and the Managing Partner. You will have significant autonomy and direct impact on both the product and the business.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi agent systems that solve real business problems for enterprise clients.
  • Architect and implement agent orchestration, coordination, handoffs, shared state, and communication between specialized agents within their multi agent platform.
  • Integrate agents with enterprise systems (ERPs, CRMs, accounting platforms, APIs) to execute workflows end to end in production environments.
  • Build evaluation frameworks and production monitoring for deployed agents, logging agent decisions, tracking accuracy, cost, and latency, and implementing feedback loops.
  • Work within client systems to understand existing workflows and translate messy business processes into agent executable architectures.
  • Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements to accelerate future delivery.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of LLM capabilities, agent frameworks, implementation patterns, and the evolving AI product development stack.
  • Deliver technical artifacts including agent skills, sub agents, API integrations, and supporting infrastructure that will be used in production workflows.
  • Contribute to internal product development, shaping the architecture and capabilities of their platform alongside the engineering team.


Requirements:

  • Production agent experience:  You have built AI agents that are currently running in production for real companies. You can point to systems you built that people use every day.
  • Python proficiency:  Strong programming skills with Python as your primary language. You ship clean, maintainable production code.
  • LLM fluency:  Deep working knowledge of prompt engineering, context window management, and model selection. You know when to use a smaller model vs. a frontier model and why.
  • Enterprise integration experience:  You have connected agents to real business systems: ERPs (Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP), CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), accounting platforms (QuickBooks, Xero), or comparable enterprise APIs.
  • Evaluation and monitoring in production:  You have built observability into agents. You know how to log agent decisions, track accuracy and cost, and build feedback loops that improve agent performance over time.
  • Multi agent orchestration:  You have designed or built systems where multiple specialized agents coordinate, hand off tasks, and share state to accomplish complex workflows.
  • High agency:  You can take a messy business problem and turn it into a working agent architecture without hand holding. You thrive in ambiguity and move fast with minimal direction.
  • Portfolio / case study:  You must be able to walk us through at least one agent system you built that is live and being used by a real company. We want to understand the business problem, your architecture decisions, and how it is performing.


Nice to Haves:

  • TypeScript, Java, or a strong second language beyond Python.
  • Customer facing or consulting experience, you have worked directly with clients or stakeholders to scope and deliver technical projects.
  • Domain experience in financial services, CPG, legal, or the music industry.
  • Cost optimization thinking, token management, caching strategies, model routing to keep agent operating costs viable for clients.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions, or similar).
  • Former technical founder or early stage startup experience, you have worn many hats and shipped under resource constraints.


What We Offer:

  • Direct impact, you will shape both their products and their client engagements from day one.
  • Exposure to diverse enterprise AI challenges across multiple industries and verticals.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build AI systems used in real-world production environments.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Client Experience Specialist
description:
Overview


AdaptCFO is a fast-growing outsourced accounting and finance firm supporting small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S.


We are hiring a Client Experience Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of client delivery, billing accuracy, and operational coordination across the business.


This role sits at the center of our organization, working directly with clients, our accounting team, and leadership to ensure:


  • Deliverables are completed on time and within budget
  • Billing is accurate and aligned with work performed
  • Clients are supported and retained
  • Operational processes run efficiently as we scale


Success in this role means creating a consistent, reliable client experience while reducing internal bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for growth.


This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a clear path into leadership as the company grows.




Key Responsibilities



Client Experience & Communication


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
  • Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
  • Proactively identify and resolve client issues




Delivery & Budget Accountability


  • Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
  • Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
  • Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
  • Flag risks early and drive resolution




Billing & Revenue Accuracy


  • Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
  • Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
  • Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
  • Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes




Upsells & Account Growth


  • Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
  • Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
  • Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow




Onboarding


  • Support onboarding of new clients
  • Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
  • Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows




Team Coordination


  • Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U.S.-based CFOs
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
  • Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed




Operations & Process Improvement


  • Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
  • Support operational structure as the company scales




What Success Looks Like


  • Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
  • Monthly closes are consistently on time
  • Work is delivered within budgeted hours
  • Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
  • Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
  • Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution




Qualifications


  • 2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

title: Especialista em vendas SaaS
description:
Empresa nacional parceira Google, atuante na comercialização de serviços inteligência em nuvem e outras soluções inovadoras como Gemini, Workspace e Keepti.


Especialista em vendas (SaaS)


Desenho de atuação:

  • Converter as oportunidades qualificadas (SQLs) geradas pela equipe de pré-vendas (SDRs) em novos negócios e receita para a empresa. A missão do Especialista de Vendas é conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas a partir da qualificação, desde a apresentação da solução até a negociação e assinatura do contrato, superando as metas de vendas e construindo relacionamentos de valor com os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações e demonstrações consultivas do produto/serviço, focando nas dores e necessidades específicas do lead;
  • Desenvolver e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas e de alto impacto;
  • Conduzir follow-ups estratégicos para avançar a oportunidade no funil de vendas;
  • Mapear e contornar objeções complexas, tanto técnicas quanto comerciais;
  • Conduzir negociações de preço, prazos e condições contratuais com tomadores de decisão;
  • Utilizar técnicas avançadas de fechamento para garantir a assinatura do contrato e a aquisição do novo cliente;
  •  Gerenciar o pipeline de oportunidades (SQLs), garantindo um forecast de vendas preciso e atualizado.• Manter todas as etapas da negociação e os próximos passos rigorosamente documentados no CRM.• Colaborar com outras áreas (jurídico, financeiro, implantação) para garantir uma transição suave do novo cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com os principais stakeholders e tomadores de decisão nas contas-alvo;
  • Atuar como um consultor, ajudando o cliente a enxergar o valor e o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) da solução.


O que buscamos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em vendas complexas ou de soluções de tecnologia (SaaS);
  • Gestão de metas de vendas;
  • Habilidade em prospecção e fechamento;
  • Competências: resiliência, visão estratégica, e comunicação. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas negociações complexas simultaneamente, cumprimento de processos e negociação.
  • Domínio das metodologias de vendas consultivas (como SPIN Selling e The Challenger Sale) para diagnosticar problemas e conduzir negociações;
  • Conhecimento em retorno sobre o Investimento (ROI);
  • Conhecimento em CRM e LinkedIn Sales Navigator e gestão do pipeline.


O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação Home office;
  • Benefícios: R$ 460,00;
  • Remuneração composta por fixo R$ 4.000,00 (CLT) e comissão variável por metas e resultados.

title: Human Resources Assistant
description:
Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions


  • Do you live in BRAZIL  and have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? 
  • Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? 
  • Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? 
  • Can you type both fast and accurately? 
  • Are you not satisfied with your current job or career and willing to start from the beginning to build your career in a company that has an abundance of opportunities to learn and grow your knowledge, career, and income? 
  • Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law? 
  • Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail? 
  • Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? 
  • Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? 
  • Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities? 


If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!  


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:

Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established. 


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum Education/Experience Requirements   

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT:   

  • Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.  
  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required.  (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). 
  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.  
  • A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.  A Master's Degree is preferred.
  • Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.  
  • 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Preffered Skills & Experience


- 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer

Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript

- Hands-on experience with React and Angular in production environments

- Solid understanding of SQL and relational data modeling

- Experience working with CI/CD frameworks and pipelines

- Familiarity with cloud-native application development

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


- Experience with Vue.js and/or Astro

- Knowledge of AWS services, including:

DynamoDB

Cognito

- Experience with Next.js

- Exposure to serverless or event-driven architectures


Job Description


We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in modern JavaScript frameworks to design, build, and maintain scalable web applications. This role requires deep frontend expertise with exposure to cloud services, databases, and CI/CD practices.

Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable web applications

Build reusable, maintainable frontend components using modern frameworks

Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions

Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices and coding standards

Integrate frontend applications with APIs and backend services

Support CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable, automated deployments

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance


Compensation

130-160 BRL per hour

description:
Job Title: Urgent: Brazilian Portuguese Audio Transcription Specialist (2-Hour Paid Trial)


About the Project: We at Thoth AI are looking for language specialists based in Brazil to join a short-term audio transcription and labeling project for AI training (ASR/TTS). This project kicks off with a 2-hour paid trial this Tuesday or Wednesday.

  • Target Language & Location: First-language proficiency (C2 level) in Brazilian Portuguese , currently based in Brazil . You must have a deep understanding of local idioms, accents, and cultural nuances.

  • Availability: Must have at least 2 hours of availability this Tuesday (March 31) or Wednesday (April 1) to complete the trial task.


What We Offer:

  • Paid Trial: If your CV passes our initial screening, you will be compensated for the 2-hour trial task upon completion.
  • Long-term Potential: Successful candidates may be invited to join our ongoing, large-scale linguistic projects.


How to Apply: Please send your CV, highlighting your Brazilian Portuguese proficiency, your English comprehension skills, and your previous experience with Adobe Audition. We are screening on a rolling basis—apply now!

title: Sr. Data Scientist, GenAI Products
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $5,500 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a talented Data Scientist specializing in Generative AI applications. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI models, directly impacting our client's platform's ability to provide interactive and intelligent tools for users. This key technical role requires hands-on expertise across data science, machine learning, and AI solutions. You will manage the lifecycle of artificial intelligence algorithms and tools across a variety of domains. The Foundry Team will support with domain knowledge.


For context, you will be collaborating on comprehensive applications/web development for highly complex projects; typically, you will work as part of a team to implement complex business solutions, deliver strategic and expert coding, and focus on overarching development strategy for a large, complex, multi-faceted application. May manage a number of projects simultaneously.


Responsibilities Include:

AI Tool Development and Implementation

  • Design and implement efficient data pipelines for data collection, cleaning, labeling, and preprocessing
  • Ensure quality of datasets tailored for LLM training for each product. Build data science pipelines from feature generation, data visualization and models evaluation; design the solution, build code and provide documentation with ways of working to maximize time to value, re-usability, and scalability.
  • Designing, developing, deploying, and implementing multi-agent AI tools that:

○ Assess and provide feedback on venture-related submissions

○ Automatically generate pitch decks, financial projections, marketing strategies, and other materials to support entrepreneurs

○ Act as a counterparty to simulate important entrepreneurial interactions such as customer interviews, negotiations with an investor, etc.

○Designing generative AI models using techniques like natural language processing and machine learning that can power interactive tools on the Foundry platform.

  • Designing an AI-powered system that collects key factors to determine a learner’s profile, entrepreneurial progress, and venture progress, and provides customized learning pathways based on these factors.
  • Integrating AI tools into the Foundry platform in a seamless manner so they are easy for users to access and utilize.
  • Collaborate on technical vision to accelerate product impact through cutting-edge LLM innovations.
  • Building guardrails, compliance rules, and oversight workflows into the GenAI tools and Foundry platform.
  • Continually improving AI tools using feedback from users to ensure they are providing valuable assistance.

Project and Performance Management

  • Monitor, debug, track, and resolve production issues.
  • Work with the Foundry Project Director to ensure that projects proceed on time and on budget.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to ensure proper tracking of performance KPIs and prioritize improvements based on effort and impact.
  • Presenting prototypes and progress updates to stakeholders.

Research and Collaboration

  • Staying up to date on the latest advances in AI/ML research and identifying how new techniques could enhance the Foundry platform.
  • Collaborating with a team of engineers, designers, and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality, helpful AI-powered experiences.
  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.


This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience
  • Advanced degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field within AI/ML


Additional/Desired Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer or similar – background as a Software Engineer is a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience building (Generative) AI models and tools
  • 3+ years of experience in programming skills in Python  and frameworks like TensorFlow
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS
  • Experience working in a similar role in a startup environment is preferred
  • Expertise in NLP, deep learning , and other relevant techniques
  • Experience building advanced workflows such as retrieval augmented generation, model chaining, dynamic prompting, PEFT/SFT, etc., using Langchain and similar tools
  • Experience working with a variety of relational SQL and NoSQL databases , big data tools (such as Hadoop, Spark, Kafka).
  • Experience integrating AI into consumer-facing applications (front-end and back-end development for integrating AI solutions into web applications
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications using tools (such as NeMo)
  • Experience with various embedding models and setting up and tuning vector databases to improve the performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Experience in using version control systems such as Git.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with API development and integration for AI services.
  • Understanding of and experience with of software engineering best practices like version control, CI/CD, and containerization
  • Experience establishing model guardrails and developing bias detection and mitigation techniques for AI applications
  • Proficiency with various prompting techniques, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs between prompting and finetuning
  • Experience with fine-tuning embedding models and tuning vector databases to improve the performance of semantic search and retrieval systems
  • Experience operationalizing end-to-end machine learning applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Passion for using AI to solve real-world problems


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge generative AI solutions that directly impact real-world entrepreneurial and learning experiences.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Analytics Governance Engineer – Python, SQL & BI Tools
description:
Role: Analytics Governance Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Time: Mountain or Central are preferred.

Location : 100% Remote


We are looking for an Analytics Governance Engineer to drive BI governance and ensure consistency across reporting platforms. Build Python/SQL jobs to extract and analyze BI metadata

title: Data Analyst
description:
POSITION SUMMARY


Our client is a rapidly growing Microsoft 365 and Workplace Management consultancy with offices in the UK, Asia and LATAM. They are 100% committed to fostering the growth and development of all our team members. They offer a range of professional development opportunities to support both permanent staff and contractors in advancing their skills and careers. Through training programs, mentorship, and access to industry resources, they ensure that everyone has the tools and support needed to succeed and grow within the organisation.


They are looking for someone who is versatile, with great analysis and documentation skills to work with our project teams to develop data solutions and carry out analysis for our customers. Excellent English-speaking skills and a flexible attitude are a must!


Candidates MUST be located and living in Brazil. Applications from other countries will be immediately rejected.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Analyse, clean and organize raw data from multiple sources
  • Model and display data with storytelling back to the business and to the programme team
  • Explain and present technical information to non-experts and support and coach users on technologies
  • Produce and maintain dashboard reports on project and data migration activity
  • Troubleshoot Excel related issues such as macros and linked files
  • Carry out ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for related data migration projects
  • Create and maintain adhoc and operational reports
  • Troubleshoot data migration issues as and when required


EXPERIENCE


  • Minimum 2 years working as a Data Analyst
  • 2 years experience creating and deploying custom PowerBI dashboards
  • Experience working on IT infrastructure projects (desirable)
  • Experience working with Microsoft 365 data (desirable)
  • Experience working in data migration projects and ETL processes
  • Experience developing and maintaining Management Information (MI) reports


QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS


  • Business/B2+ Level English
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • High level of numeracy and attention to detail
  • Advanced Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA)
  • Strong PowerBI (PowerQuery, M, DAX)
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • Python Scripting skills (Pandas, NumPy, Seaborn, Matplotlib)
  • PowerShell scripting (desirable)
  • SQL skills (desirable)
  • Developer skills (desirable)
  • Microsoft Dataverse (desirable)
  • Microsoft Intelligent Data Platform (desirable)
  • Good PowerPoint and presentation skills
  • Experience working with IT systems and related projects (desirable)
  • Motivated self-starter
  • Personable and professional manner


Our client actively encourages applications from individuals with disabilities and try to provide access, adjustments, equipment, or other practical support where required. They welcome applications from people with backgrounds that are traditionally underrepresented in tech and truly believe diversity is the key to creativity and innovation.

title: Technical Support Analyst (SAP ATLAS)
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail‑oriented IT Technical Support Engineer to join our ATLAS (Automation of Customer Life Cycle across SAP) team.

In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting the end‑to‑end lifecycle of SAP solution landscapes for enterprise customers — from onboarding through offboarding. You’ll work across teams to ensure landscapes are accurately configured, monitored, and transitioned through key lifecycle stages while delivering high‑quality, reliable support.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem‑solving, collaboration, and ownership , and who thrives in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage and drive resolution of customer issues in collaboration with internal and external support teams
  • Investigate and resolve tickets raised via Jira (and soon ServiceNow )
  • Validate customer landscape configurations, lifecycle statuses, and key milestones using internal tools
  • Identify root causes of discrepancies (e.g., incorrect system statuses, missing dates) and implement corrective actions
  • Coordinate with internal and customer‑facing units (CFUs) to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution
  • Ensure operational data (fulfilment dates, landscape statuses, etc.) is accurate and compliant with internal policies
  • Support reliability and availability efforts aligned with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles
  • Document solutions and contribute to knowledge bases, process wikis, and operational documentation
  • Mentor new team members during onboarding, feature rollouts, or process changes
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to enhance efficiency and service quality
  • Create and analyze reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to track trends and performance metrics


Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Experience in IT Technical Support, customer operations, or enterprise system support
  • Advanced English
  • Exposure to ITSM frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Hands‑on experience supporting at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Experience working in or alongside Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills for troubleshooting complex issues
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non‑technical teams
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
  • Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast‑paced, high‑volume environment
  • A strong sense of ownership with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement
  • Willingness to learn complex systems and contribute to continuous operational improvement


Nice to Have


  • Understanding of SLA/KPI‑driven operations
  • Familiar with SAP ATLAS
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software solutions , ideally SAP‑related.

title: Jr Partnerships Manager
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: (SDR) Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Essa vaga é para SDR Júnior (PJ-REMOTO), sem experiência como SDR mas com experiência com vendas.  


 Estamos em busca de um SDR para ajudar a escalar nossa operação comercial em uma empresa de tecnologia focada em monitoramento e rastreamento veicular.


Você não precisa ter experiência, nós daremos todo o treinamento que você precisa para executar bem a sua função, além de que o supervisor vai estar sempre lado a lado com você no desenvolvimento da sua carreira, para que você aprenda a executar o trabalho de SDR (Pré-venda). 

Como SDR, você será responsável por identificar e qualificar leads. Você irá se comunicar com potenciais clientes por telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e Linkedin para identificar suas necessidades e agendar reuniões com a equipe de vendas dos nossos clientes. 

Não é necessário ter experiência prévia como pré-venda, mas é importante que você já tenha trabalhado com relacionamento ao cliente ou vendas, seja comunicativo e tenha habilidades de persuasão para criar interesse nos potenciais clientes. Além disso, você deve ser capaz de trabalhar em equipe, ter boa capacidade de organização e ser capaz de aprender rapidamente sobre nossos produtos e serviços. 

Principais responsabilidades:  

  • Identificar e qualificar leads; 
  • Contatar potenciais clientes por telefone, whatsApp, e-mail e linkedin para apresentar os produtos e serviços dos nossos clientes; 
  • Qualificar potenciais clientes e agendar reuniões com a equipe de vendas dos nossos clientes 
  • Manter registros precisos e atualizados das interações com os clientes em nosso sistema CRM; 
  • Participar de reuniões e rotinas diárias da empresa. 

Requisitos:  

  • Habilidade para aprender rapidamente sobre nossos produtos e serviços; 
  • Boa capacidade de organização e gerenciamento de tempo; 
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com outros membros; 
  • Não necessita experiência como pré venda. 

Oferecemos:  

  • Treinamento completo para desenvolver suas habilidades como SDR  
  • Ambiente de trabalho desafiador e motivador 
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional 
  • Salário inicial de R$ 1.800 fixo + Comissão por performance 
  • Plano de carreira com metas de crescimento.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.


To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent mindset while enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value candidates with full software lifecycle experience, encompassing requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing support.


Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry
  • Strong passion for backend architecture and application development, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Building and optimizing high-load, high-performance, data-driven backend systems
  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir e evoluir estratégias de uso de IA Generativa e LLMs;
  • Atuar na customização e otimização de modelos, conforme contexto do projeto;
  • Estruturar e preparar dados para treinamento e melhoria contínua dos modelos;
  • Conduzir análises e avaliações comparativas entre diferentes abordagens de IA;
  • Garantir qualidade dos outputs, considerando consistência, aderência ao contexto e redução de falhas;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de performance e eficiência das soluções;
  • Apoiar a definição da arquitetura mais adequada de IA, com base em dados e resultados;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio, garantindo alinhamento e direcionamento claro.



Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vivência com IA Generativa e modelos de linguagem (LLMs);
  • Experiência com NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento, avaliação e otimização de modelos;
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas modernas de IA (ex: RAG, agentes, fine-tuning);
  • Experiência com cloud AWS;
  • Experiência com Python e ferramentas de dados/IA;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação com diferentes stakeholders.
